name: Tsunade (S)
description: As the Fifth Hokage and one of the Legendary Sannin, Tsunade possesses extraordinary physical strength and unparalleled medical ninjutsu. By combining her devastating attacks with Katsuyu's healing abilities and her mastery of chakra control, she protects her allies while overwhelming her enemies on the battlefield.
unlock: Mission: The Will of the Senju

skills.name: Shattering Fist
skills.description: Concentrating an immense amount of chakra into her fist, Tsunade destroys one enemy's destructible defense and removes their damage reduction, dealing 25 damage to them.

skills.name: Katsuyu's Colossal Form
skills.description: Tsunade summons a massive portion of Katsuyu's body with 80 health. While Katsuyu remains summoned, this skill is replaced by 'Network Healing', and Tsunade gains 25% unpierceable damage reduction.

skills.name: Medical Chakra Synchronization
skills.description: Using her exceptional chakra control and medical ninjutsu, Tsunade establishes a connection with an ally, first healing herself for 35 health and then setting that ally's health to be the same as hers.

skills.name: Exceptional Chakra Shielding
skills.description: This skill makes Tsunade invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Network Healing
skills.description: Tsunade channels Katsuyu's life force into an ally or herself, healing that character for 20 health and reducing Katsuyu's health by 20 points.
